title: Design System: EnglishMaster — Botanical Study Ledger

display.purpose: Large tabular score numerals and hero titles with tight tracking.

headline.purpose: Top-level screen headers and section banners (Be Vietnam Pro ExtraBold 800).

title.purpose: Card headings, course names, and skill specimen titles (ExtraBold/Bold).

body.purpose: Vietnamese-first study prose, AI feedback, and reading passages (height 1.5).

label.purpose: Buttons, pill chips, and tabular-figure counters.

shadows.name: tactile-button-edge
shadows.purpose: Crisp 4dp solid bottom edge under primary ChunkyButton at rest; collapses to 0dp on press.

shadows.name: tactile-card-edge
shadows.purpose: 3dp solid ledger bottom edge under OutlinedCard and StatTile containers.

shadows.name: tactile-specimen-edge
shadows.purpose: 4dp semantic pigment bottom edge under SkillTile, FlatHeroCard, and AI prompt/score cards.

motion.name: press-mechanical
motion.purpose: Physical 4dp vertical translation on button press and release.

components.name: Chunky Primary Button
components.description: Primary 56dp tactile CTA with a 4dp solid #104943 bottom edge that physically depresses on tap.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1B6E66; color: #FFFFFF; min-height: 52px; padding: 14px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #104943; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 90ms ease, box-shadow 90ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #175E57; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 #104943; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1B6E66; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chunky Outlined Button
components.description: Secondary tactile button on pure paper surface with a 2dp border and 4dp bottom ledger edge.
components.css: .ds-btn-outlined { background: #FFFFFF; color: #15201C; min-height: 52px; padding: 14px 20px; border: 2px solid #D2DDD6; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #D2DDD6; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 90ms ease, box-shadow 90ms ease; } .ds-btn-outlined:hover { border-color: #1B6E66; } .ds-btn-outlined:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 #D2DDD6; }

components.name: Skill Specimen Tile
components.description: 116dp semantic skill block (Speaking/Listening/Writing/Reading) with 2dp pigment border, 4dp bottom edge, and framed icon box.
components.html: Luyện nói
components.css: .ds-skill-tile { background: #FCE4D2; color: #5C2D12; border: 2px solid #E6B99C; border-radius: 24px; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #E6B99C; padding: 14px; width: 140px; height: 112px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 90ms ease; } .ds-skill-tile:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-skill-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; } .ds-skill-icon { width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.62); border: 1.5px solid #E6B99C; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-skill-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; }

narrative.overview:
EnglishMaster is crafted as a tactile botanical study ledger and modern language press. Instead of noisy gamified gradients or sterile corporate gray, every screen rests on warm herbarium vellum paper (#F6F7F4) with deep pine-charcoal ink (#15201C), anchored by Botanical Emerald (#1B6E66) for primary actions and Warm Amber Seal (#F2911B) for streaks and rewards.

Each of the four English skills owns a strict, museum-grade natural pigment family across the entire app: Terracotta Clay for Speaking, Eucalyptus Mint for Listening, Iris Vellum for Writing, and Mineral Cobalt for Reading. Depth is mechanical rather than atmospheric: zero blurred drop shadows or gradients; every interactive button and specimen card carries a crisp 2dp border and a solid 3–4dp bottom edge that depresses physically under the thumb.
keyCharacteristics: Warm herbarium vellum paper ground (#F6F7F4 light / #0E1412 dark) with ≥ 4.5:1 WCAG AA contrast across all 12 semantic text/surface pairs
Strict 4-skill natural pigment color-coding (Speaking Terracotta, Listening Mint, Writing Iris, Reading Cobalt) with matching 2dp borders and 4dp bottom edges
Zero gradients and zero blurred box-shadows; tactile mechanical depth via 3–4dp solid bottom edges
Be Vietnam Pro local typography (weights 400–800) with tabular figures (tnum) across all scores, timers, streaks, and VND prices

rules.name: The Four-Pigment Canon Rule
rules.body: Speaking is always Terracotta Clay (#FCE4D2 / #5C2D12), Listening is always Eucalyptus Mint (#D4F0E2 / #0F5238), Writing is always Iris Vellum (#E6E0FA / #3D2C7A), and Reading is always Mineral Cobalt (#DAE9FA / #17427A). Never swap skill pigments or use literal hex codes outside AppPalette.

rules.name: The Tabular Ledger Rule
rules.body: Every numeric score, IELTS band, countdown timer, streak day counter, flashcard mastery ratio, and VND price uses FontFeature.tabularFigures() so columns and rings never jitter.

rules.name: The Mechanical Edge Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never cast blurred drop shadows or linear gradients. Depth is expressed exclusively through 2dp structural borders and 3–4dp solid bottom edges that collapse to 0dp when pressed.

dos: Do source every surface, ink, border, and skill pigment from AppPalette.of(context) so Light and Dark modes stay in lockstep.
Do pair every colored skill surface with its matching 2dp colors.edge border and colors.ink foreground.
Do preserve white (#FFFFFF) paper and dark (#171923) ink on QR payment codes in both Light and Dark themes for reliable scanning.
Do test responsive layouts across 344dp (Fold cover), 360dp (phone), 673dp (unfolded foldable), 800dp (tablet), and 1280dp (desktop/large tablet).
donts: Don't introduce linear/radial gradients, glassmorphic blurs, or blurred BoxShadow elevations anywhere in the widget tree.
Don't fabricate progress percentages, countdown timers, or activity totals that are not returned by the real API.
Don't allow any semantic text-on-surface pair to fall below 4.5:1 WCAG AA contrast in either Light or Dark mode.
